title: StarRTT: An End-to-End Real-Time Framework for Blind Zone-Free RTT Prediction in Starlink LEO Satellite Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.32540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite mega-constellations such as Starlink require frequent handovers due to high orbital velocities, resulting in substantial Round-Trip Time (RTT) fluctuations. Accurate RTT prediction can mitigate these fluctuations, yet it fundamentally relies on continuously updated serving- satellite information. translated_title: StarRTT：一种面向星链低轨卫星网络无盲区RTT预测的端到端实时框架
translated_abstract: 诸如星链（Starlink）等低地球轨道（LEO）卫星巨型星座由于轨道速度高，需要频繁进行切换，导致往返时延（RTT）出现显著波动。准确的RTT预测可以缓解这些波动，但其从根本上依赖于持续更新的服务卫星信息。现有的服务卫星识别方法通常只能在每个调度周期结束时才完成识别，由此形成识别盲区，限制了实时预测。为克服这一限制，我们开发了StarRTT，这是一种端到端的实时框架，通过将每秒一次的服务卫星识别与RTT预测相集成，消除了该盲区。在该框架内，我们提出了实时长短期记忆网络（RT-LSTM），这是一种基于LSTM的RTT预测模型，旨在同时捕获非平稳的RTT演化特性以及服务卫星之间随时间变化的几何关系。
tldr: 提出StarRTT端到端实时框架，将每秒服务卫星识别与RT-LSTM预测模型相结合，消除了星链低轨卫星网络中RTT实时预测的识别盲区。
en_tdlr: StarRTT is an end-to-end real-time framework that eliminates the identification blind zone in Starlink LEO satellite networks by integrating per-second serving-satellite identification with the RT-LSTM RTT prediction model.
